地址: China, Shenzhen, Futian District, 中心城 邮政编码: 518017
描述: Fun 8/10. Free Sky deck on 116F (547 m). ¥180 online / ¥200 on site; 10:00-20:00 (Fri-Sat 21:00). Enter ~16:30 for sunset. Metro: 购物公园 Exit D.

名称: 慢慢生活馆·中泰式按摩·SPA（会展中心店）
描述: Fun 7/10. 金中环商务大厦 A座 21F, room 2109 — 会展中心站 E exit. Open 10:30–23:30; last slots ~21:30. Book ahead on Klook, Trip.com or Ctrip. Chinese/Thai massage, oil and hot-stone.

名称: 深圳当代艺术与城市规划馆
地址: 184 Fuzhong Rd, 中心城 Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, China, 518000
描述: Fun 7/10. Free, no booking, Tue-Sun 10:00-18:00 (closed Mondays). Giant city model + the 改革开放 exhibition; striking building.

Fun 9/10. 世纪汇广场, 深南中路3018号. ¥268 weekday / ¥298 weekend, 10:00–22:00, wristband re-entry all day. Go-karts, laser tag, ice rink, PS5/Switch, KTV pods, arcade, bowling. Night ticket ¥168 after 19:00. Join their WeChat group for 20 free claw coins.
Fun 6/10. 华强北路1002号. Six floors of components, phones, laptops, drones, repair shops — Asia's densest electronics market. Know your price before you go.
Fun 5/10. 华强北. Imported Korean/Japanese/Western cosmetics at near-duty-free prices. Check batch codes and expiry; little room to haggle on branded goods.

地址: 深圳市福田区莲科一路 (Upper Hills, Futian)
描述: Fun 7/10. Big open-air mall: coffee, design shops, rooftop-style lanes. A footbridge links it straight into 莲花山公园 — 15-20 min up to the Deng Xiaoping statue for the classic CBD skyline sunset, free. Best half-day: coffee here, park at golden hour.
Fun 6/10. 振兴路55号, 华强北. Two floors, 100+ stalls: imported snacks, nuts, drinks, gift boxes at wholesale prices even for one item. Buy a box, not a bag.

地址: 2 Jingtiandong St 1st, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, China, 518034
描述: Fun 3/10. Neighbourhood arts centre at 景田东路2号. Check the programme; first-trip travellers can skip it.

地址: 5018 Shennan E Rd, Luohu District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, China, 518010
描述: Fun 4/10. Only worth it with a booked performance; otherwise a pass-by near Mixc City Crossing.

地址: 1881 Baoan Rd S, Luohu District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, China
描述: Fun 5/10. Classic luxury mall — good rain plan, food court and cinema.

地址: China, Guangdong Province, Shenzhen, Luohu District, 永新路 邮政编码: 518010
描述: Fun 3/10. Generic mall attached to the food city — useful only as a shortcut or an AC break.

地址: China, Guangdong Province, Shenzhen, Luohu District, 东门永新路 邮政编码: 518010
描述: Fun 7/10. Dense snack stalls in Dongmen; the best cheap eating on the list. Go hungry, in the evening.

地址: China, Guangdong Province, Shenzhen, 二横街步行街白马服装市场6层
描述: Fun 6/10. Shenzhen's original bargain-shopping street. Loud, cheap, snack-heavy — 1-2 h is plenty.
Fun 5/10. 鸿展商城, 东门步行街, 6 floors: 2F women's, 3-4F men's, 5F export surplus. Some stalls want 2+ pieces. Best 16:00-18:00 when they clear stock.
Fun 7/10. 15 km of waterfront path along the bay — Hong Kong's hills on the far side, the Houhai skyline behind you. Free, flat, best 30 min before sunset.
Fun 7/10. Former factory blocks turned galleries, design shops and the best independent coffee in the city. Busy on weekends, sleepy on weekday mornings. 1–2 h.

名称: 水贝国际珠宝交易中心
描述: Fun 6/10. Shenzhen processes most of China's gold here. Price = weight + labour fee (工费) — always ask the 工费 separately and ask for a certificate. Weekdays are calmer.
Fun 6/10. 130 replicas of world landmarks in one park — kitsch, but the Eiffel copy and the evening show are genuinely fun. ¥220ish, half a day if you go in.

地址: GXR4+J6F, Nanshan, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, China, 518058
描述: Fun 7/10. Best-designed mall in town: outdoor lanes, flagships, strong restaurant floor.
Fun 6/10. The campus behind 万象天地: glass towers, the 深圳湾创业广场 square, and a walkable waterfront that runs into 人才公园. Tencent's Binhai towers are 1 km east. 45 min on foot.

地址: GW6W+FFQ, Nanshan, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, China, 518065
描述: Fun 8/10. Free bay-front loop with the Houhai skyline. Best light 17:00-18:30; pair with dinner in Houhai. Metro: 人才公园 Exit.
Fun 3/10. Local mall/theatre by Talent Park — a convenience stop, not a destination.
Fun 6/10. 南海大道南油第一工业区 — dozens of buildings of original-design women's wear, Korean/European labels, higher quality than Dongmen. 10:00-19:00.
Fun 5/10. Restored old village turned shopping street. Your contact found it thin — treat it as a coffee/food stop (1.5-2 h), not a headline sight.

地址: China, Guangdong Province, Shenzhen, Baoan, 15, 西南方向170米 邮政编码: 518052
描述: Fun 8/10. 'Bay Glory' wheel ¥150 (¥180 holidays), 10:30-22:00. Promenade + evening light show. Metro: 临海 Exit B2.
